description.zh: 文件上传任务id。可通过调用[UploadFile](~~2850466~~)接口创建上传任务获取，或通过[ListUploadTasks](~~2851127~~)接口查询已有任务
description.en: The file upload task ID. You can obtain this by calling the [UploadFile](~~2850466~~) operation to create an upload task, or by calling the [ListUploadTasks](~~2851127~~) operation to query existing tasks.
